metadata.title: The Macachor Scalar Field & Structural Convergence Framework: Mathematical Refinement v3.0
metadata.description:
This repository contains the hardened mathematical formulation (v3.0) of the Macachor Scalar Field theory, alongside its foundational epistemological framework (The Structural Convergence Principle and The Validation Boundary).

Key Features:

  • Mathematical Hardening: Explicit positivity postulates, fixed background metric formulation, and proof of local exponential stability of the Macachor Lock state (ψ = M).
  • Epistemological Boundary: Formalizes the limit of empirical measurement: 'Measurement can test derivations. Measurement cannot define the primitive.'
  • Computational Validation: A Python script verifying Lyapunov energy dissipation (dF/dt ≤ 0) and perturbation decay.
  • Cryptographic Provenance: Links the mathematical model to the immutable SHA-256 locked conceptual invariant.

This work establishes a mathematically testable scalar-field model, deliberately withholding unproven global convergence claims pending further analysis, and resolves the historical category error of reified vector forces.
